title: Pythagorean identity for graph points
statement: For all n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝⁿ and y ∈ ℝ^ℓ (Euclidean spaces Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Rn ℓ), the graph point graphPoint x y = toLp 2 (Fin.append (ofLp x) (ofLp y)) ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (first n coordinates x, last ℓ coordinates y) satisfies ‖graphPoint x y‖² = ‖x‖² + ‖y‖² (Euclidean norms).
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint x y‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 + ‖y‖ ^ 2
